clips.title: The story
paras: Fel Moss spreads through Teldrassil’s forests, its insidious corruptive energies carried by hostile grell and grellkin. The taint threatens the World Tree’s wildlife and native furbolg tribes.

Corruption has reached Teldrassil’s boughs, though the World Tree was planted to restore the night elves’ immortality and heal the natural world. Fel Moss is one clear sign of that decay. Impish grell and grellkin infest Shadowglen, with the unnatural, wicked magic of the moss clinging to them and radiating from their growth. The dryad Tarindrella gathers samples to measure how deeply the rot has entered the sacred woodland canopy.
